plugin.name: SugarCube
plugin.title: SugarCube
plugin.desc: A modified version of the SugarCube plugin with artist weighting, Floating Wobble, a SugarCube Quick Settings page for on-the-fly Filter/Recipe/Genre/Artist/Mood mixing with automatic track replacement, robust multi-player support, and the ability to sync settings across selected players.
plugin.creator: Charles Parker, AF1, HB64
